notes.title: Spidle Tridle on Steam
notes.content:
Welcome to Spidle Tridle!

"[i]Spidle Tridle: Didle lidle insidle :D[/i]" - some player on Kongregate, circa 2017
"[i]Spiddle Triddle? I don't get it![/i]" - some girl on YouTube, circa 2017

What is it? [b]Spidle Tridle is a relaxed, minimalist idle builder game about resource extraction and refinement on the far-away planet Trappist 1d[/b]. Some of you may remember this title from its previous life as a web game on Kongregate. Fret no more, the Steam version is coming very soon.

While a classic game like this requires handling with care, I did take the liberty to do a polishing pass on top of making sure that the basics for running as a standalone version are working fine. 

Before release, I'll be working on stability, polish, and [b]sound effects and music[/b] (which the game never had before)

After release, I don't know yet! I'll make sure the game runs smoothly and without hiccups or undue jank for everybody. Other than that, it all depends on [b]community feedback[/b] (that's you!).

Thanks for taking the time to read through this little announcement - I can't wait to hear your thoughts on the game once it's out there. Have a good one!

Cheers
solinv
